summary: Tested job photos (Emergent Object Storage) end to end. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass against the public URL. Covered: upload of JPEG and PNG returning exactly the fields id, client_id, content_type, size and created_at; list in upload order; file bytes returned byte-identical with the correct content-type; text/pdf, empty and >12MB files rejected with 400; missing 'file' field gives 422; no auth gives 401/403; another user gets an empty list and 404 on file/delete; soft delete gives 404 on file and the photo is no longer listed, and a second delete gives 404; draft flow (upload photos to a uuid, then POST /clients with the same id lists the photos). UI at 390px, on /prossimi-lavori, ClientFormDialog: the photo section, camera input (capture=environment) and gallery input (multiple) are all present. The empty state shows. set_input_files with 2 images shows an uploading spinner tile, then 2 thumbnails with images. A 2000px JPEG is compressed to 1600px. Viewer: counter 1/2, next/prev wrap around, close keeps the job dialog open. Delete via confirm leaves 1 thumbnail and closes the viewer. Persistence after a page reload works. New job: a photo added before saving is still there after saving and reopening (same photo id). A second new job starts empty, so the draft id is regenerated. Editing notes and saving still persists ('TEST note foto' confirmed via API). The /rilievi page loads. No horizontal overflow (390/390) and no console or page errors. Test data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: Deleting a job does not soft-delete its job_photos: there are no photo references in routes/clients.py. Files and docs stay orphaned.

Any client_id is accepted, which is needed for drafts. But if the user cancels a new job after adding photos, those photos stay orphaned in storage and DB forever. Consider a cleanup on cancel, or a periodic sweep of photos whose client_id does not exist.
The whole file is read into memory before the 12MB check. Acceptable for the MVP.

issues: Uploads run one after another and the uploading counter goes up one file at a time, so with N photos only one spinner tile shows at a time instead of N placeholders. Cosmetic only.
blobCache is a module-level Map whose objectURLs are never revoked. This is a small memory leak over a long session.
Upload errors show a generic toast ('Foto non caricata, riprova') and ignore the backend detail (for example 'Formato immagine non supportato').

action_items: Optional: cascade soft-delete of job_photos when a client is deleted
Optional: clean up draft photos when a new job dialog is cancelled without saving
critical_code_review_comments: ClientFormDialog.jsx is about 800 lines (more than 700). Consider splitting it.
The photos list is capped with to_list(200) and there is no per-job limit on uploads.
